Get a taste of our secret sauce

Drupal Powers a Nationwide Support Network

Image
Built by Factorial, DAISIE is a Drupal 10 platform that enables 8,000 volunteers across 104 TelefonSeelsorge offices to deliver 24/7 crisis support through a unified, accessible system for scheduling, collaboration, and case management. The platform balances local autonomy with centralized oversight, helping Germany’s leading crisis helpline meet growing demand for support.
Learn more about TelefonSeelsorge

Drupal Platform Evolution for Higher Education

Image
Princeton SPIA partnered with Evolving Web over many years, supporting the evolution of its Drupal-powered digital presence as the School continues to shape global policy leaders. Most recently, SPIA became one of the first Princeton sites to implement the university's new institutional branding, setting the standard for how updated brand elements translate to digital across the entire university. The component-based Drupal architecture established through earlier migration work made this possible without rebuilding from the ground up, proving the long-term value of a flexible, well-structured Drupal platform.
Learn more about Princeton SPIA

Scaling Public Health on Drupal

Image
The American Medical Association (AMA) partnered with Axelerant to consolidate its fragmented ecosystem of WordPress and Drupal sites into a unified Drupal platform. The solution replaced a plugin-heavy, high-risk environment with a secure, scalable, and governed Drupal architecture, introducing structured content models, standardized editorial workflows, and improved accessibility and SEO. This transformation enables AMA to deliver consistent, reliable public health communications while supporting collaboration across multiple stakeholders.
Learn more about AMA
